title: Guard height judged as printed, at most 4.5 mm
summary: C13 measures the guard bands on the printed shape (petgasus._guard_band_heights: the solid's vertical run through the prop plane at points round each arc, median), not as guard_z1 - guard_z0, which read 4.00 whatever was drawn. Printed, the bands are 4.15-4.9 mm (median 4.2): the optimiser's rim sits just under each 4 mm band. The author set the limit to 4.5 mm: the extra is below the band and outside the prop's disc, no duct.

rejected.why: fails by 0.2 mm on rim material under the band that adds no duct effect; the author chose 4.5 mm (2026-10-17)

rejected.value: re-solving with nothing allowed under the bands
rejected.why: ~45 min of optimiser runs and re-validation, with the limbs forced to join the bands from the sides; the author chose to restate the claim instead
